name: discriminantly
description: Keep the things you notice, the places you go and the experiences worth remembering, and work with them through your connected AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Discriminantly is an app and plugin that connects to your AI, giving you a place to keep the things you notice, the places you go, and the experiences worth remembering.

Add to it through ordinary conversation. Tell ChatGPT about a bookshop you want to remember, a watch you bought, or a restaurant you went to last night, and it is kept in your Discriminantly catalogue as a note, a travel mark or a check-in. Ask what you have saved from a city, group things into collections, and plan a trip with an itinerary built from the places you already know.

You stay in control. Notes and places can be private or shared with other members. Everything ChatGPT adds or changes is recorded as ChatGPT acting for you, and you can see and edit all of it in the Discriminantly app. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time in Settings.
capabilities: Keep notes about things you notice
Save places worth remembering as travel marks
Check in at places you have been
Group notes and places into collections
Plan trips with itineraries of days and stops
Find what you have kept by place, name or tag
Keep items private from other members
defaultPrompt: What places have I saved in London?
Keep this place: Hatchards bookshop on Piccadilly, London.
Plan a weekend from the places I have saved in Lisbon.
